newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FJ Benjamin shares drop on poor results.
newsitem.headline: FJ Benjamin shares drop on poor results.

text.p: The share price of luxury retailer FJ Benjamin Holdings Ltd fell to a new year low of Singapore $0.94 on Thursday after it posted disappointing half-year results for 1996.
At 0415 GMT, the shares topped the actives with more than 2.8 million shares traded and were down S$0.185 at S$0.955.
"It is being sold down because of its disappointing results," said a broker with a local institution.

On Wednesday, FJ Benjamin reported a 29.7 percent drop in profits for the half year ended December 31, 1996 to S$3.72 million. It said they were affected by the poor performance of its Australian operations.
According to Edinburgh Financial Publishing's Estimate Directory, FJ Benjamin was expected to post full year earnings of S$14 million.
Analysts said they have revised down projected earnings for the company and were calling a sell on the stock.
"There is no way FJ Benajmin is able to meet the full year target," said one analyst with a European house.
